description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractDownstreamSender, which implements message sending functionalities for a downstream messaging client in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes methods for constructing messages with payloads, properties, and content types, and relies on Proton for message handling. The class is part of a client implementation to send messages downstream to Hono infrastructure.

classes.name: AbstractDownstreamSender
classes.description: An abstract class providing implementation for sending messages downstream in the Hono client, utilizing Vertx Proton, with methods for message construction and payload handling.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Constructs and sends a message with specified payload, device ID, properties, and content type, returning a Future for the delivery.

methods.name: getCharsetForContentType
methods.description: Parses the content type header to determine the Charset for encoding the payload.

methods.name: addProperties
methods.description: Adds device-specific properties to the message.
